data.title: Telling Time — Beginner · Lesson 1
data.subject: time
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Hey, can I get a coffee, please?)

[Hook]
At the café… En la cafetería
Time flies by… El tiempo pasa
Morning light… Luz de la mañana
Let's learn today… Aprendamos hoy
The clock is ticking… El reloj avanza

[Verse]
Sitting here, sipping my tea,
feeling calm, feeling free.
The hour… La hora
The minute… El minuto
Every second counts, can't you see?
What time is it?… ¿qué hora es?
It's one o'clock… Es la una
It's two o'clock… Son las dos
Time to learn, let's hit the clock.

[Hook]
At the café… En la cafetería
Time flies by… El tiempo pasa
Morning light… Luz de la mañana
Let's learn today… Aprendamos hoy
The clock is ticking… El reloj avanza

[Verse]
People come, people go,
in this cozy little show.
A greeting… Un saludo
Good vibes… Buenas vibras
Let's chat and laugh, let it flow.
The sun sets… El sol se pone
Night arrives… Llega la noche
Under the stars, our dreams roam.

[Bridge]
In this moment, right here, right now,
we're learning fast, we'll figure it out.
